description: Audit entry recording: caller context, action catalogue and details.

cases.inputs: action: "user.created"; objectType: "User"; objectId: U1; actorId: A1; details: { email: "lan@x.vn", fullName: "Lê Văn Lan" }.
cases.return: Completes; one audit row is added with the actor A1, the action, object type and id, IP 203.0.113.7 and details JSON {"email":"lan@x.vn","fullName":"Lê Văn Lan"}, and saved at once in its own unit of work.

cases.log: Audit row written with empty details.
cases.return: Completes; the row is saved with details "{}" (the column is NOT NULL, so nothing to add is an empty object).

cases.inputs: details: { name: "Thư ký phó" } containing Vietnamese letters.
cases.return: Details JSON is stored with the letters as themselves ("Thư ký phó"), not as \u escapes.

cases.inputs: actorId: null; objectType: "GuestSession"; objectId: S1; details: { meetingId, guestInvitationId }.
preconditions: A Guest verifies an invitation (no account acts).
cases.return: Completes; the row is saved with a null actor and the invitation in the details.

cases.exception: Persistence exception from saving the audit row.
cases.return: The persistence error reaches the caller; no row is stored.
